notes: Loreilal and Silturn match wiki names; official SN5 manual instead prints Loirelal and Silturan. These are recorded variants, not justification to silently rename approved project terms.
The four world titles and Sapureth/Maetropa spellings are independently supported by the official SN5 manual search extract. This is naming evidence, not proof of an official English SN3 translation.
Wiki.gg Air Colthearts search extract lists all four proposed affinity names. Yokai is accepted over the older Youkai/Oni variants for consistency with the chosen source.

Possession is a defensible literal mechanic term. Japanese SN3 wiki distinguishes timed beneficial and harmful possession effects from status ailments; this does not independently prove an official English label.

Several direct wiki/manual fetches were blocked; their search-indexed extracts were checked instead. Direct Maetropa page title verification was unavailable; its spelling and Beast World title were independently supported by the official manual and other wiki entries.
Do not automatically replace every occurrence of a single Japanese affinity glyph in running prose; normalize only classified term usages.
